title: Retrieve routing hash from id when missing

timeline.message: Retrieve routing hash from id when missing
timeline.author: Kostas Krikellas

timeline.body:
In `applyTranslogOperation`, the routing field in the `DocumentParserContext`'s `SourceToParse` is not set, while the id is. Post parsing in `TimeSeriesRoutingHashFieldMapper` should retrieve the routing hash from the id prefix in this case.

Fixes #106550

Why is this test removed? 
Maybe add a test where `routingHash` (^) is null? Or could this test cover this?

reply.body:
This would hit the assert, it's not possible to reach the case where both the id and routing are null and the exception is thrown.

Good point though, restored and modified the test to cover the new logic.

timeline.author: Kostas Krikellas

timeline.body: Can we also assert that the Lucene document contains a field for the routing field with the expected value?

reply.body: Moved to the right place and added.

timeline.author: Kostas Krikellas
